ui.vote.reveal_hint: Cards open in a moment. Look at the big screen.
ui.vote.inspect_hint: Swipe through the cards. Voting opens soon.
ui.vote.vote_hint: Tap Vote on the card you want. You can change it until time runs out.
ui.vote.runoff_hint: No majority. Choose between the top two.
ui.vote.not_voter: You joined after this round opened. Watch this one; you vote in the next.
ui.vote.removed_by_veto: Your vote was on a vetoed option. Vote again.
ui.vote.removed_option: Your vote was cleared: that option can no longer win.
ui.vote.runoff_reset: Runoff: all votes were reset. Vote again.
ui.vote.veto_body: You have one veto per mission. It removes this option for everyone, and votes on it are cleared.
ui.vote.tags.title: Role tags
ui.vote.predict.title: Predict
ui.vote.predict.hint: Your first answer is final. Correct predictions earn 50 KP.
ui.vote.predict.locked: Locked in. Waiting for the others.
ui.vote.predict.wrong: Not this time. The answer was {answer}.
ui.vote.trivia.title: Tie! Trivia sudden-death
ui.vote.trivia.hint: First correct answer picks the winner among the tied options.
ui.vote.trivia.locked: Answer sent. Fastest correct answer wins.
ui.vote.trivia.winner_you: You were fastest! Pick the winner.
ui.vote.trivia.winner: {name} answered first and picks the winner.
ui.vote.trivia.nobody: Nobody got it. The coin decides.
ui.vote.result.title: Decision
ui.vote.result.emergency: Emergency Funding used: PM's ability is now spent.
ui.vote.decision_time_hint: FLIGHT ability: end this vote now. Once per mission.
ui.vote.option.TEST.detail: Costs money and days, may reveal a hidden flaw.
ui.vote.option.SKIP.detail: Saves money and days, keeps the risk.
ui.card.emergency_ok: Choosing it spends PM's Emergency Funding
ui.card.fix_exists: A later vote can still fix this
ui.card.no_fix: No later vote can fix this
ui.card.tap_stat: Tap a stat for a short explanation
ui.card.more_stats: More stats below. Scroll or tap to see them.
ui.card.no_stats: No figures for this option. Compare strengths and drawbacks.
ui.card.explain_lead: Days until the part is delivered. The longest lead time sets the schedule.
ui.card.explain_integ: Days to fit and check the part. Integration days add up across parts.
ui.card.explain_reliability: Chance that the part works on this flight. The band shows how sure we are.
ui.stat.thrust.label: Thrust
ui.stat.thrust.explain: Push of the engine at sea level / in vacuum. More thrust lifts more mass.
ui.stat.isp.label: Isp
ui.stat.isp.explain: Specific impulse: how efficiently propellant becomes speed. Higher means more Δv per tonne of fuel.
ui.stat.isp_s.label: Isp
ui.stat.isp_s.explain: Specific impulse: how efficiently propellant becomes speed. Higher means more Δv per tonne of fuel.
ui.stat.throttle.label: Throttle
ui.stat.throttle.explain: How far the engine can throttle down. Deep throttling helps through Max Q and for landings.
ui.stat.cost.label: Cost
ui.stat.cost.explain: Price of this option in game money. It comes out of the contract budget.
ui.stat.mass_t.label: Mass
ui.stat.mass_t.explain: Every tonne of dry mass is a tonne less payload or less Δv.
ui.stat.mass_kg.label: Mass
ui.stat.mass_kg.explain: Every kilogram carried costs propellant all the way to orbit.
ui.stat.mass_each_t.label: Mass each
ui.stat.mass_each_t.explain: Mass of one booster. Multiply by the number of boosters.
ui.stat.restarts.label: Restarts
ui.stat.restarts.explain: How many times the engine can relight in flight. Needed for landings and multi-burn orbits.
ui.stat.propellant.label: Propellant
ui.stat.propellant.explain: Fuel and oxidiser pair. It sets efficiency, tank size and handling.
ui.stat.pointing_accuracy_deg.label: Pointing accuracy
ui.stat.pointing_accuracy_deg.explain: How precisely the spacecraft can aim. Smaller is better for cameras and antennas.
ui.stat.computer_count.label: Computers
ui.stat.computer_count.explain: Redundant flight computers. More of them survive a single failure.
ui.stat.radiation_hardened.label: Radiation hardened
ui.stat.radiation_hardened.explain: Hardened electronics resist bit flips from cosmic rays.
ui.stat.crew_capacity.label: Crew
ui.stat.crew_capacity.explain: Number of astronauts the capsule seats.
ui.stat.cargo_capacity_t.label: Cargo
ui.stat.cargo_capacity_t.explain: Cargo the capsule can carry besides its crew.
ui.stat.service_module_mass_t.label: Service module
ui.stat.service_module_mass_t.explain: Mass of the module that provides power and propulsion to the capsule.
ui.stat.endurance_days.label: Endurance
ui.stat.endurance_days.explain: How long the system supports the mission on its own.
ui.stat.data_rate_GB_per_pass.label: Data per pass
ui.stat.data_rate_GB_per_pass.explain: Data sent to Earth during one ground-station pass.
ui.stat.pointing.label: Pointing
ui.stat.pointing.explain: How accurately the antenna must be aimed at Earth.
ui.stat.continuous_coverage.label: Continuous coverage
ui.stat.continuous_coverage.explain: Always in contact, not only during ground passes.
ui.stat.stage.label: Stage
ui.stat.stage.explain: Which stage this option belongs to.
ui.stat.engine_count.label: Engines
ui.stat.engine_count.explain: More engines add thrust and can survive an engine failure, but add mass and parts.
ui.stat.engine_out_capability.label: Engine-out
ui.stat.engine_out_capability.explain: Whether the stage can still reach orbit if one engine fails.
ui.stat.engine_out_bonus.label: Engine-out margin
ui.stat.carried_all_flight.label: Carried all flight
ui.stat.carried_all_flight.explain: Mass that rides the whole way costs Δv the whole way.
ui.stat.jettison_time_s.label: Jettison
ui.stat.jettison_time_s.explain: Seconds after lift-off when it is dropped.
ui.stat.abort_envelope_key.label: Abort envelope
ui.stat.abort_envelope_key.explain: When during the flight it can pull the crew to safety.
ui.stat.abort_envelope_max.label: Protects up to
ui.stat.abort_envelope_max.explain: The highest flight phase where an abort still saves the crew.
ui.stat.diameter_m.label: Diameter
ui.stat.diameter_m.explain: Inside width. The payload must fit with its solar wings folded.
ui.stat.reusable.label: Reusable
ui.stat.reusable.explain: Recovered hardware lowers the cost of later flights.
ui.stat.max_entry_speed_km_s.label: Max entry speed
ui.stat.max_entry_speed_km_s.explain: Fastest atmospheric entry the shield survives. Faster returns need a stronger shield.
ui.stat.reference_capsule_mass_t.label: Capsule mass
ui.stat.reference_capsule_mass_t.explain: Capsule mass the shield was sized for.
ui.stat.power_W.label: Power
ui.stat.power_W.explain: Electric power the instrument needs while it works.
ui.stat.data_GB_per_day.label: Data
ui.stat.data_GB_per_day.explain: Science data produced per day. It must fit through the radio link.
ui.stat.science_stars.label: Science value
ui.stat.science_stars.explain: How much science the instrument returns, from 1 to 5.
ui.stat.sees_through_clouds.label: Sees through clouds
ui.stat.sees_through_clouds.explain: Can image the ground even when clouds cover it.
ui.stat.works_at_night.label: Works at night
ui.stat.works_at_night.explain: Instruments that do not need sunlight can image on the night side.
ui.stat.requires_cooling.label: Needs cooling
ui.stat.requires_cooling.explain: This sensor must be kept cold, which costs power and mass.
ui.stat.power_duty.label: Power duty
ui.stat.power_duty.explain: When the instrument draws its power.
ui.stat.latitude_deg.label: Latitude
ui.stat.latitude_deg.explain: Distance from the equator. Sites near the equator get more help from Earth's spin.
ui.stat.eastward_boost_m_s.label: Eastward boost
ui.stat.eastward_boost_m_s.explain: Free speed from Earth's rotation when launching east.
ui.stat.min_inclination_deg.label: Min inclination
ui.stat.min_inclination_deg.explain: Lowest orbit tilt reachable without a costly plane change.
ui.stat.loop_type.label: Loop
ui.stat.loop_type.explain: Open loop throws away air and water; regenerative recycles them.
ui.stat.landing_method_key.label: Landing
ui.stat.landing_method_key.explain: How the lander reaches the ground.
ui.stat.insertion_error_km.label: Insertion error
ui.stat.insertion_error_km.explain: Typical miss distance at orbit insertion. Smaller is better.
ui.stat.precise_attitude.label: Precise attitude
ui.stat.precise_attitude.explain: Knows its orientation precisely enough to aim instruments.
ui.stat.add_on_to.label: Add-on to
ui.stat.add_on_to.explain: Works together with this other sensor.
ui.stat.best_for_key.label: Best for
ui.stat.best_for_key.explain: The kind of mission this option suits.
ui.stat.generation_avg_W.label: Average power
ui.stat.generation_avg_W.explain: Average electric power over one orbit, including time in Earth's shadow.
ui.stat.booster_count.label: Boosters
ui.stat.thrust_sl_each_kN.label: Thrust each
ui.stat.burn_time_s.label: Burn time
ui.stat.burn_time_s.explain: How long the booster fires before it is dropped.
ui.stat.cost_each_M.label: Cost each
ui.stat.mirrors_first_stage.label: Copies first stage
ui.stat.mirrors_first_stage.explain: Side boosters built like the core stage.
ui.stat.cost_first_stage_mult.label: Cost factor
ui.stat.size.label: Size
ui.stat.size.explain: Tank size class. Bigger tanks hold more propellant and give more Δv but weigh more.
ui.stat.first_stage_propellant_t.label: 1st-stage propellant
ui.stat.first_stage_propellant_t.explain: Propellant loaded in the first stage.
ui.stat.upper_stage_propellant_t.label: Upper-stage propellant
ui.stat.upper_stage_propellant_t.explain: Propellant loaded in the upper stage.
ui.stat.fixed_propellant_t.label: Fixed propellant
ui.stat.fixed_propellant_t.explain: A solid motor carries a fixed load of propellant.
ui.ping.title: Quick pings
ui.poll.your_call_hint: Answer for your consoles. NO-GO stops the count for a discussion.
ui.poll.all_go_detail: Flight is GO. Stand by for the countdown.
ui.poll.no_go_detail: The crew discusses on the big screen, then FLIGHT polls again.
